relevance.rationale: WRONG JOIN — REPORT LOUDLY, and note this is the SECOND file in this slice mis-joined to 'faddeev_kashaev1994' (the other is library/arxiv-1102.3530v1/1102.3530v1.pdf). The registered entry under that id is a mid-1990s physics-letters article; the attached file is a two-author math.QA arXiv preprint, id 2509.02354v2, on the holonomy braiding for quantum sl2 at a root of unity. No matching id exists in folio/schema/references.ts — the nearest same-surname entry (mcphail-snyder2026, references.ts:5249) is a different preprint on diagrammatic state integrals — so id is set to null. RELEVANCE: substantial and close to live QOU work. The document derives an explicit holonomy R-matrix for quantum sl2 at a root of unity, shows it factorizes into a product of FOUR quantum dilogarithms, and proves it satisfies a holonomy Yang-Baxter equation. QOU carries a dilogarithm-pentagon-associator line (prop:dilog-pentagon-is-associator, lean/QOU/QuantumObservableUniverses/DilogPentagonAssociator.lean, lean/QOU/QBeta/CyclicDilogPentagon.lean, braids-and-knots/pentagon-uv-commutation-woronowicz.lean) whose entire content is the relation between quantum dilogarithms and braiding/associativity data — this is a current, explicit realisation of that relation. Held at supporting: QOU's pentagon blocks are about the associator, not about a holonomy R-matrix at a root of unity, so nothing here is a drop-in; it is the strongest available modern context, not a needed lemma.

keyResults.statement: The normalized holonomy R-matrix of quantum sl2 at a root of unity factorizes as a product of four quantum dilogarithms and satisfies a holonomy Yang-Baxter equation.
keyResults.useForFolio: A concrete realisation of the quantum-dilogarithm-to-braiding relation that prop:dilog-pentagon-is-associator asserts abstractly, in the root-of-unity regime the QBeta pentagon files work in.
